overTitle.context: Budget warning title (Budget tab, Add screen): a spending category went over its monthly limit. {name} is the category's name as the user typed it (e.g. Food), so avoid grammar that depends on its gender or case.

paceTitle.message: {name}: w tym tempie limit zostanie przekroczony
paceTitle.context: Budget warning title: at the current pace of spending, the category {name} will go over its monthly limit by the end of the month.

nearTitle.context: Budget warning title: the category {name} has used {percent}% (e.g. 85) of its monthly limit.

overTitle.context: Budget warning title: the whole month's spending, all categories together, is over the total budget.

paceTitle.message: W tym tempie budżet miesiąca zostanie przekroczony
paceTitle.context: Budget warning title: at this pace, the whole month's spending will go over the total budget by the end of the month.

nearTitle.context: Budget warning title: the whole month has used {percent}% of the total budget.

overDetail.context: Budget warning detail under an 'over the limit' title, on the last day of the month. {spent}, {limit}, {over} are amounts with currency, e.g. '1,250 zł of 1,000 zł, 250 zł over.'

overDetailDaysLeft.one: {spent} z {limit}, {over} ponad limit, a do końca miesiąca został {count} dzień.
overDetailDaysLeft.few: {spent} z {limit}, {over} ponad limit, a do końca miesiąca zostały {count} dni.
overDetailDaysLeft.many: {spent} z {limit}, {over} ponad limit, a do końca miesiąca zostało {count} dni.
overDetailDaysLeft.other: {spent} z {limit}, {over} ponad limit, a do końca miesiąca zostało {count} dnia.
overDetailDaysLeft.context: Budget warning detail under an 'over the limit' title. {spent}, {limit}, {over} are amounts with currency; {count} is the number of days left in the month.

paceDetail.one: W tym tempie ok. {projected} na koniec miesiąca przy limicie {limit}. Do {perDay} dziennie przez {count} dzień utrzyma limit.
paceDetail.few: W tym tempie ok. {projected} na koniec miesiąca przy limicie {limit}. Do {perDay} dziennie przez {count} dni utrzyma limit.
paceDetail.many: W tym tempie ok. {projected} na koniec miesiąca przy limicie {limit}. Do {perDay} dziennie przez {count} dni utrzyma limit.
paceDetail.other: W tym tempie ok. {projected} na koniec miesiąca przy limicie {limit}. Do {perDay} dziennie przez {count} dnia utrzyma limit.
paceDetail.context: Budget warning detail under a 'heading over' title. {projected} is the projected month-end spending, {limit} the limit, {perDay} how much can be spent per day to stay within it, {count} the days left. All amounts include the currency.

nearDetail.context: Budget warning detail under an 'at 85% of its limit' title, on the last day of the month. {left} is the amount still available, with currency.

nearDetailDaysLeft.context: Budget warning detail under an 'at 85% of its limit' title. {left} is the amount still available, {count} days left in the month, {perDay} the amount per day. Amounts include the currency.

someone.context: Used as {who} in 'privateOverTitle' when the owner of a personal allowance isn't known.

privateOverTitle.context: Budget warning title about another household member's personal allowance (pocket money category). {who} is the person's name. Deliberately shows no amounts: the allowance is private.

privateOverDetail.message: {name}: wydano więcej, niż planowano w tym miesiącu.
privateOverDetail.context: Budget warning detail about another person's private allowance. {name} is the allowance category's name. No amounts on purpose.

crossedOver.context: Short message right after saving an expense that pushed the category {name} over its monthly limit. {over} is the amount over, with currency.

crossedNear.context: Short message right after saving an expense that brought the category {name} close to its monthly limit. {percent} is e.g. 83.
